desc: Derive the rooted-subtree invariant: every processed subtree consists of completed K-vertex paths plus at most one unfinished path segment whose endpoint is the subtree root.

Specify deterministic transitions: zero open children starts a size-1 segment; one open child extends it; two open children must merge to exactly K; over two open children is invalid; size K closes immediately.
Implement an iterative parent/order traversal and reverse-order O(NK)-vertex DP in Python.
Validate with public samples and reason through edge cases including K=1, chains, and high-degree vertices.
Confirm the root is accepted exactly when it has no unfinished segment.
